notes.shelter: Up to 8 shelters, each with its own level

progress.levelAgeLocked: Saved level {level} is not open on this server yet. {text}
progress.goalAgeLocked: Goal {goal} is not open on this server yet. {text}

builders.label: Builders
builders.hint: An upgrade you start here shows on Overview as a running queue.
builders.idle: Press Start on a building to begin an upgrade.

facilities.intro: Facilities in your city. Mark the ones you have built. These are city facilities, not the alliance facilities on the Alliance menu.

tab.intro: Current level and goal for every building. Furnace sets what the rest can reach.
tab.status: Showing {shown} of {total} buildings. Goals are read only here and are set in Plan. A goal equal to the current level means no goal. Steppers move one level at a time along the game order.

empty.title: No buildings match
empty.description: Change the search or reset the filters to see every building.

start.selectHelp: Only buildings you can start now are listed. Locked, maxed and running buildings are left out. Each upgrade uses one of the two builders.
start.slotHelp: Pick an idle builder. A busy builder shows when it frees.

cancelled.title: {name} upgrade cancelled
cancelled.message: The level stays as it was. Fix your stock on Resources if needed.

massEdit.title: Mass edit applied
massEdit.message: {count, plural, one {{amount} building} other {{amount} buildings}} updated.

manage.finishText: Finish upgrade sets {name} to {level}, frees Builder {builder} and adds the upgrade to your History. At zero time left the building and the builder card say Ready to finish. Nothing finishes by itself, because you may have used speedups.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Choose what the Buildings list shows
filters.pinned: Furnace stays pinned at the top whatever the filter. Filters are not saved.

levels.title: Levels
levels.noDescription: No description in the data yet.
levels.tableNote: This table lists only the levels after your current one, since those are done.
levels.maxed: Max level. Nothing is left to upgrade.
levels.capacityNote: Capacity is only set on tier base rows in the package, so sub-levels show Unknown.

massEdit.title: Mass edit buildings
massEdit.description: Set many buildings at once. Nothing is saved until you press Set buildings.
massEdit.changes: {count, plural, one {{amount} building changes} other {{amount} buildings change}}
massEdit.raiseTitle: Raise every building to a level
massEdit.raiseHint: Each building goes up to its highest level at or below this one. A building that is already higher stays, and one that starts later stays not built. Goals are not changed.
massEdit.blockedTitle: Some buildings need another building first.
massEdit.blocked: {count, plural, one {{amount} building is} other {{amount} buildings are}} above what its requirements allow.
massEdit.lowerBlocked: Lower them to what is allowed
massEdit.footnote: Mass edit changes saved levels only. It never lowers a level on its own and never changes goals. Shelters have a level each, so set them with the Shelters button, and set the Hero Hall on the Facilities tab.

shelters.title: Shelters
shelters.description: Up to {max} can be built. Set the level of each one.
shelters.locked: The Shelter is still locked by your Furnace level.
shelters.furnaceNeeds: What your Furnace needs from shelters
shelters.footnote: The Plan and the progress bar use your lowest shelter, the next one to upgrade.

plan.title: Plan Buildings
plan.description: Resources, time and power from current level to goal
plan.failed: The plan could not be worked out.
plan.noGoals: No goals yet. Add a building above, then pick the level you want it to reach.
plan.prerequisiteNote: Prerequisite steps are added for you. A level that needs another building at a higher level counts those steps and flags them.
plan.timeNote: The plan takes {time} after the {percent}% speed bonus. Your stock: Construction {construction} min, General {general} min. General speedups count toward construction.

add.title: Add a building
add.allAdded: Every building is already in the plan.

speed.title: Construction speed
speed.bonusesOn: Carried over from the Bonuses page.
speed.bonusesOff: Turned off in Settings, under Apply my Bonuses totals.
speed.appointmentNote: Regular 10 percent, Supreme 15 percent. Estimate: the package states these values for research only.
speed.petSkillNote: The percent comes from the Cave Hyena on the Pets page, at its current level.
speed.chiefOrderNote: Estimate: adds {percent} percent construction speed for 5 minutes. The package has no chief order data, so the value is entered by the app and applied to the whole time.
speed.petSkillNoteLocked: The Cave Hyena is not unlocked on the Pets page, so the skill adds nothing. Unlock it there to turn this on.

result.title: Result, {count} steps
result.eventPoints: Event points: SvS {svs}, King of Icefield {king} (Estimate, from the scoring rows of events).
result.unmetNone: None for these goals. A building outside the list, such as Hero Hall, would show here.

export.empty: Add a goal to the plan to export it.
